title: 手動フィンガー式板金折曲機
description: 板金作業場の背景に置く手動折曲機。補強付き四脚台、平らな作業ベッド、十二個の固定クランプフィンガー、前側の角度付き折曲エプロンと両端蝶番、左右の長い操作レバー/握り、上部の締付レバー・調整つまみ、裏面銘板を造形。フィンガーやレバーは一式の部品で、モデルは1点です。板材は付属せず、可動・加工精度・荷重・安全性能は未実装・未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.636 × 1.372 × 0.891 m、7,696三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A manual folding brake for sheet-metal workshop backgrounds. It has a braced four-leg stand, flat working bed, twelve fixed clamping fingers, angled front folding apron with end hinges, two long operating levers/grips, upper clamp levers/adjustment knobs and a rear blank plate. All fingers and levers belong to one model. No sheet is included; motion, forming accuracy, load and safety performance are unimplemented and untested. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.636 × 1.372 × 0.891 m; 7,696 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
